notes.decision: Greek σταυρόω 'crucify' applied cosmologically: the Light is crucified/affixed in the Darkness. This is the Manichaean Cross of Light / Jesus patibilis motif — light suspended/suffering in matter. Preserving 'crucified' rather than weakening to 'fixed' or 'set up' retains the theological weight.

Greek ἀναίρεσις 'taking-away, removal, lifting-up.' Translated 'extraction' to capture the eschatological drawing-up of light from the mixture. The verb ⲛⲁⲉⲓ ⲁϩⲣⲏⲓ̈ 'shall come up' confirms the upward-extraction sense.
ⲙⲗⲁϩ 'strife/quarrel' (vocab) — paired here with ⲡⲡⲟⲗⲉⲙⲟⲥ 'war' as the cosmic conflict initiated by the First Man's descent.
ⲕⲉ- 'other' + ⲟⲁⲙ = ϭⲟⲙ 'power.' 'His other powers' = the supplementary forces accompanying the Gate of the Darkness.

Obscure compound. Parallel structure ⲣ ϩⲛ̄ⲭⲙⲛⲣⲱⲙⲉ ⲙ̄ⲛ ϩⲛ[ⲣⲉⲛⲉⲁ] 'made some X-men and some [generations]' suggests ⲭⲙⲛ = a generative/establishing root paralleling γενεά. Tentatively rendered 'generations of men.' Could be ϫⲡⲟ-/ⲥⲙⲛ-/ⲭⲙⲛ- root for begetting or establishing. Flag for review.

Chapter title 'Three Times' — the foundational Manichaean eschatological schema (Initial Time / Mixed Time / Final Time). The three καιροί are enumerated below: light's descent and crucifixion in darkness (Time 1) → mixed warfare while sons remain in worlds (Time 2) → final extraction (Time 3).
Translated 'purpose of heart of the Greatness' per accumulated vocabulary. The First Man's mission was the divine commission from the Father.

Both Greek loanwords for 'time' appear: ⲭⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ (chronological span) in line 5, ⲕⲁⲓⲣⲟⲥ (appointed moment) in lines 7, 13, 28-29. Preserved in transliteration where ⲭⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ but rendered 'time' for ⲕⲁⲓⲣⲟⲥ.

Translated 'powers' as Lycopolitan reflex of ⲛϭⲟⲙ/ⲛϭⲁⲙ 'powers.' The ⲁ- prefix may reflect a vocalic shift or dialectal article. Context (separation of beautiful/light from 'all the X') strongly suggests dark archonic powers.

Translated 'he drew' from ϫⲱⲗⲕ̄ 'draw, set in array.' The cosmological pairing with ⲥⲱⲍⲣⲉ 'drove down' in line 18 suggests opposite vertical motions: drew up (light) / drove down (Error). Lyc. ⲭ for ϫ regular.

Translated 'the Error' (capitalized) as nominalization of ⲥⲱⲣⲙ̄ 'go astray, err' = ⲡⲗⲁⲛⲏ. Preserves Manichaean cosmic principle. The pairing 'drove Error to the Deep' / 'drew light to the Height' is the cosmic separation.

Translated 'the abortions fell downward' — ⲍⲟⲩⲍⲉ likely Lyc. reflex of ϩⲟⲩⲣⲉ/ϩⲟⲟⲩⲗⲉ 'miscarriage, abortion.' This is the standard Manichaean myth: the Third Ambassador's revelation caused the dark archons to expel their abortions, which fell to earth. Adam and Eve are then fashioned in flesh from these. Confidence high based on cosmological context.
Visible word at end of partial line 15. ⲥⲱⲣ = 'spread, scatter' (Sah. ⲥⲱⲣ). Translated 'spread' but full clause lost in lacuna.

Identified as ἀνδριάς 'the Statue' = Manichaean Last Statue (eschatological figure of redeemed light at the end of times). Editor's reading [ⲡⲁⲛⲁ̄]ⲣⲉⲓⲁⲥ reflects damaged ⲇ̄. The eschatological context ('time when X will come upward at the end') confirms this technical term.

Both Greek loanwords (χρόνος / κλῆρος) recur throughout the page in apparent semi-synonymy. ⲭⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ = 'time/era' (the temporal extent), ⲕⲁⲗⲣⲟⲥ (κλῆρος) = 'lot, allotted portion, term' (the assigned segment). The text distinguishes them: there are three κλῆροι/χρόνοι spanning from the First Man through the establishment of the cosmos by Father+Mother of Life through the Ambassador's revelation until Panaretos. I render ⲭⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ as 'time' and ⲕⲁⲗⲣⲟⲥ as 'term' (allotted span).
Greek Παναρετος ('all-virtuous'). Manichaean eschatological figure who comes at the end against the bōlos. Retained as transliterated proper name 'Panaretos' to flag the technical-onomastic status.

ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈ = ⲉϩⲣⲁⲓ̈ ('upward'); with ⲍⲙ̄ ('upon, against'). Translated 'come up against the clod' — Panaretos rises up against the bōlos at the eschatological consummation. Preserves vertical-directional semantics required by Manichaean cosmic physics.
Reading as ϩⲟⲩⲟ + ⲥⲁⲃⲕ ('more, lesser') = comparative 'is lesser' — fits the rhetorical structure where the middle period is being measured against the first.
ϩⲁⲥⲕ from ϩⲱⲥⲕ 'delay, prolong, stretch out' + 'in much/excess' = 'much longer.' The duration of the first man's time exceeds the Ambassador's term.
Lexeme uncertain. Possibly ⲁⲟⲩⲗⲉ 'shoot, sucker' (vegetative growth) — fits the agricultural register established in earlier kephalaia where men become trees/shoots. Tentative.
Lyc reflex of ϩⲗⲟϭ 'sweet, sweetness.' 'Land of sweetness' = Land of Light, paralleling the paired terminology ⲡⲕⲁⲍ ⲉⲧⲁⲛⲓⲧ in earlier kephalaia.
